lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਾਫੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਆਵਗੀਰ ਸਭਿ ਉਘੜਿ ਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa satigur saraaph nadar kar dekhai suaavageer sabh ughaR aae ||
lines.translation: When the True Guru, the Tester, observes with His Glance, the selfish ones are all exposed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਜੇਹਾ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਤੇਹਾ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਓਇ ਤੇਹੋ ਜੇਹੇ ਦਯਿ ਵਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi jehaa chitavahi nit tehaa paain oi teho jehe day vajaae ||
lines.translation: As one thinks, so does he receive, and so does the Lord make him known.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਹੀ ਸਿਰੀ ਖਸਮੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਚਲਤ ਸਬਾਏ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak duhee siree khasam aape varatai nit kar kar dekhai chalat sabaae ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord and Master is pervading at both ends; He continually acts, and beholds His own play. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਮਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗੈ ਸੋ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik man ik varatadaa jit lagai so thaai paai ||
lines.translation: The mortal is of one mind - whatever he dedicates it to, in that he is successful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਗਲਾ ਕਰੇ ਘਨੇਰੀਆ ਜਿ ਘਰਿ ਵਥੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: koee galaa kare ghanereeaa j ghar vath hovai saaee khaai ||
lines.translation: Some talk a lot, but they eat only that which is in their own homes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur sojhee naa pavai aha(n)kaar na vichahu jaai ||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, understanding is not obtained, and egotism does not depart from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ ਨੋ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਹੈ ਹਥੁ ਤਡਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਗਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aha(n)kaareeaa no dukh bhukh hai hath tadahi ghar ghar ma(n)gaai ||
lines.translation: Suffering and hunger cling to the egotistical people; they hold out their hands and beg from door to door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਠਗੀ ਗੁਝੀ ਨਾ ਰਹੈ ਮੁਲੰਮਾ ਪਾਜੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR thagee gujhee naa rahai mula(n)maa paaj lahi jaai ||
lines.translation: Their falsehood and fraud cannot remain concealed; their false appearances fall off in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis hovai poorab likhiaa tis satigur milai prabh aai ||
lines.translation: One who has such pre-ordained destiny comes to meet God through the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਲੋਹਾ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਵਰਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu lohaa paaras bheteeai mil sa(n)gat suvaran hoi jaai ||
lines.translation: Just as iron is transmuted into gold by the touch of the Philosopher's Stone, so are people transformed by joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak ke prabh too dhanee jiu bhaavai tivai chalaai ||2||
lines.translation: O God, You are the Master of servant Nanak; as it pleases You, You lead him. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin har hiradai seviaa tin har aap milaae ||
lines.translation: One who serves the Lord with all his heart - the Lord Himself unites him with Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਸਾਝਿ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀ ਸਭਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun kee saajh tin siu karee sabh avagan sabad jalaae ||
lines.translation: He enters into a partnership with virtue and merit, and burns off all his demerits with the fire of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਗਣ ਵਿਕਣਿ ਪਲਰੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਸਚੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: augan vikan palaree jis dehi s sache paae ||
lines.translation: Demerits are purchased cheap, like straw; he alone gathers merit, who is so blessed by the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਮੇਟਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਟੀਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: balihaaree gur aapane jin augan met gun paragateeaae ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has erased my demerits, and revealed my virtuous merits.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੇ ਕੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: vadee vadiaaee vade kee guramukh aalaae ||7||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh chants the glorious greatness of the great Lord God. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur vich vadee vadiaaee jo anadin har har naam dhiaavai ||
lines.translation: Great is the greatness within the True Guru, who meditates night and day on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਮਤ ਸੁਚ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam ramat such sa(n)jam har naame hee tripataavai ||
lines.translation: The repetition of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is his purity and self-restraint; with the Name of the Lord, He is satisfied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਰਖ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam taan har naam deebaan har naamo rakh karaavai ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is His power, and the Lord's Name is His Royal Court; the Lord's Name protects Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ਪੂਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸੋ ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo chit laai pooje gur moorat so man ichhe phal paavai ||
lines.translation: One who centers his consciousness and worships the Guru, obtains the fruits of his mind's desires.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਮਾਰ ਦਿਵਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo ni(n)daa kare satigur poore kee tis karataa maar divaavai ||
lines.translation: But one who slanders the Perfect True Guru, shall be killed and destroyed by the Creator.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫੇਰਿ ਓਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਓਸੁ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਓਹੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: pher oh velaa os hath na aavai ohu aapanaa beejiaa aape khaavai ||
lines.translation: This opportunity shall not come into his hands again; he must eat what he himself has planted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਰਕਿ ਘੋਰਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਖੜਿਆ ਜਿਉ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਪਾਇ ਗਲਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: narak ghor muhi kaalai khaRiaa jiu tasakar paai galaavai ||
lines.translation: He shall be taken to the most horrible hell, with his face blackened like a thief, and a noose around his neck.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਵੈ ਤਾ ਉਬਰੈ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: phir satigur kee saranee pavai taa ubarai jaa har har naam dhiaavai ||
lines.translation: But if he should again take to the Sanctuary of the True Guru, and meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, then he shall be saved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਾਤਾ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har baataa aakh sunaae naanak har karate evai bhaavai ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak speaks and proclaims the Lord's Story; as it pleases the Creator, so does he speak. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਮੰਨੈ ਓਹੁ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਮੁਠਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: poore gur kaa hukam na ma(n)nai ohu manamukh agiaan muthaa bikh maaiaa ||
lines.translation: One who does not obey the Hukam, the Command of the Perfect Guru - that self-willed manmukh is plundered by his ignorance and poisoned by Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜੋ ਕਰਿ ਬੁਝੈ ਅਣਹੋਦੇ ਝਗੜੇ ਦਯਿ ਓਸ ਦੈ ਗਲਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: os a(n)dar kooR kooRo kar bujhai anahode jhagaRe day os dai gal paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Within him is falsehood, and he sees everyone else as false; the Lord has tied these useless conflicts around his neck.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਗਲ ਫਰੋਸੀ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੀ ਓਸ ਦਾ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ohu gal pharosee kare bahuteree os daa boliaa kisai na bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He babbles on and on, but the words he speaks please no one.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਹੰਢੈ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਨ ਦੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਓਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੁਹੁ ਜੋੜੇ ਓਸੁ ਭੀ ਲਛਣੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ohu ghar ghar ha(n)dhai jiu ra(n)n douhaagan os naal muhu joRe os bhee lachhan laaiaa ||
lines.translation: He wanders from house to house like an abandoned woman; whoever associates with him is stained by the mark of evil as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਓਸ ਦਾ ਪਾਸੁ ਛਡਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਬਹਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hoi s alipato varatai os daa paas chhad gur paas bahi jaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who become Gurmukh avoid him; they forsake his company and sit near the Guru.
